// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
// Test inputs/oracles: Copyright Grafana Labs contributors; adjacent LICENSE applies.
// Standard-library-only source extraction. Never executes Loki/Pulse or computes hashes/oracles.
// Usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki > pipeline-ownership.json
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"

type object map[string]any
type pair struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Value string `json:"value"`
}
type source struct {
	path string
	data []byte
	fs   *token.FileSet
	file *ast.File
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func hash(b []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(b)) }
func load(root, path, want string) *source {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, path))
	must(err)
	if hash(b) != want {
		panic("source differs from pinned revision: " + path)
	}
	fs := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fs, path, b, parser.ParseComments)
	must(err)
	return &source{path, b, fs, f}
}
func (s *source) code(n ast.Node) string {
	return string(s.data[s.fs.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:s.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset])
}
func (s *source) record(n ast.Node) object {
	a, b := s.fs.Position(n.Pos()), s.fs.Position(n.End())
	return object{"source": s.path, "original_go": s.code(n), "source_range": object{
		"start_line": a.Line, "start_column": a.Column, "end_line": b.Line, "end_column": b.Column,
		"start_byte": a.Offset, "end_byte_exclusive": b.Offset}}
}
func (s *source) selection(name string, n ast.Node) object {
	r := s.record(n)
	end := s.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset
	if end >= len(s.data) || s.data[end] != '\n' {
		panic("missing original trailing newline")
	}
	text := s.code(n) + "\n"
	r["name"], r["original_go"], r["sha256"] = name, text, hash([]byte(text))
	switch d := n.(type) {
	case *ast.FuncDecl:
		if d.Doc != nil {
			r["documentation"] = s.record(d.Doc)
		}
	case *ast.GenDecl:
		if d.Doc != nil {
			r["documentation"] = s.record(d.Doc)
		}
	}
	return r
}
func (s *source) function(name string) *ast.FuncDecl {
	for _, d := range s.file.Decls {
		if f, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok && f.Name.Name == name {
			return f
		}
	}
	panic("missing function: " + name)
}
func calls(s *source, n ast.Node, prefix string) []object {
	out := []object{}
	ast.Inspect(n, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
			name := s.code(c.Fun)
			if len(name) >= len(prefix) && name[:len(prefix)] == prefix {
				out = append(out, s.record(c))
			}
		}
		return true
	})
	return out
}
func literal(e ast.Expr) string {
	l, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
	if !ok || l.Kind != token.STRING {
		panic("expected string literal")
	}
	v, err := strconv.Unquote(l.Value)
	must(err)
	return v
}
func boolean(e ast.Expr) bool {
	i, ok := e.(*ast.Ident)
	if !ok || (i.Name != "true" && i.Name != "false") {
		panic("expected literal Boolean")
	}
	return i.Name == "true"
}
func integer(e ast.Expr) int64 {
	l, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
	if !ok || l.Kind != token.INT {
		panic("expected integer literal")
	}
	v, err := strconv.ParseInt(l.Value, 10, 64)
	must(err)
	return v
}
func isNil(e ast.Expr) bool { i, ok := e.(*ast.Ident); return ok && i.Name == "nil" }

// Only these four source-defined string aliases are admitted. Their declarations
// and full-file hashes are preserved separately. No error messages are generated.
var aliases = map[string]string{}

func text(s *source, e ast.Expr) string {
	if l, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit); ok && l.Kind == token.STRING {
		return literal(e)
	}
	if v, ok := aliases[s.code(e)]; ok {
		return v
	}
	panic("unknown string expression: " + s.code(e))
}
func copyPairs(p []pair) []pair { return append([]pair{}, p...) }
func set(p []pair, n, v string) []pair {
	p = copyPairs(p)
	for i := range p {
		if p[i].Name == n {
			p[i].Value = v
			return p
		}
	}
	return append(p, pair{n, v})
}

// Resolve source label assignments only, not pipeline behavior, sorting, String
// rendering, StableHash, or LabelsResult methods. appendLabels is literal Set
// assignment replay from its preserved helper; Builder.Set is likewise explicit.
func labelsValue(s *source, e ast.Expr, env map[string][]pair) []pair {
	if i, ok := e.(*ast.Ident); ok {
		if v, ok := env[i.Name]; ok {
			return copyPairs(v)
		}
		panic("unknown label reference: " + i.Name)
	}
	c, ok := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	if !ok {
		panic("unknown label expression: " + s.code(e))
	}
	switch s.code(c.Fun) {
	case "labels.EmptyLabels":
		if len(c.Args) != 0 {
			panic("EmptyLabels arity")
		}
		return []pair{}
	case "labels.FromStrings":
		if len(c.Args)%2 != 0 {
			panic("odd label pairs")
		}
		out := []pair{}
		for i := 0; i < len(c.Args); i += 2 {
			out = append(out, pair{text(s, c.Args[i]), text(s, c.Args[i+1])})
		}
		return out
	case "appendLabels":
		if len(c.Args) != 2 {
			panic("appendLabels arity")
		}
		out := labelsValue(s, c.Args[0], env)
		for _, p := range labelsValue(s, c.Args[1], env) {
			out = set(out, p.Name, p.Value)
		}
		return out
	}
	// The only chained label constructor in these tests is NewBuilder(x).Set(n,v).Labels().
	if sel, ok := c.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && sel.Sel.Name == "Labels" && len(c.Args) == 0 {
		if sc, ok := sel.X.(*ast.CallExpr); ok && len(sc.Args) == 2 {
			if ss, ok := sc.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && ss.Sel.Name == "Set" {
				if bc, ok := ss.X.(*ast.CallExpr); ok && s.code(bc.Fun) == "labels.NewBuilder" && len(bc.Args) == 1 {
					return set(labelsValue(s, bc.Args[0], env), text(s, sc.Args[0]), text(s, sc.Args[1]))
				}
			}
		}
	}
	panic("unknown label call (hash/String may not become literals): " + s.code(e))
}
func lineValue(s *source, e ast.Expr) (string, bool) {
	if c, ok := e.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
		if s.code(c.Fun) != "[]byte" || len(c.Args) != 1 {
			panic("unknown line conversion")
		}
		if isNil(c.Args[0]) {
			return "", true
		}
		return literal(c.Args[0]), false
	}
	return literal(e), false
}
func bytes(v string) string { return base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(v)) }
func matcher(s *source, e ast.Expr) object {
	c := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	if s.code(c.Fun) != "labels.MustNewMatcher" || len(c.Args) != 3 || s.code(c.Args[0]) != "labels.MatchEqual" {
		panic("unsupported matcher constructor")
	}
	r := s.record(e)
	r["type"], r["name"], r["value"] = "equal", text(s, c.Args[1]), text(s, c.Args[2])
	return r
}
func stage(s *source, e ast.Expr) object {
	c := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	name := s.code(c.Fun)
	r := s.record(e)
	r["constructor"] = name
	switch name {
	case "NewStringLabelFilter":
		if len(c.Args) != 1 {
			panic("label filter arity")
		}
		r["matcher"] = matcher(s, c.Args[0])
	case "newMustLineFormatter":
		if len(c.Args) != 1 {
			panic("formatter arity")
		}
		r["template"] = literal(c.Args[0])
	case "NewLogfmtParser":
		if len(c.Args) != 2 {
			panic("logfmt arity")
		}
		r["strict"], r["keep_empty"] = boolean(c.Args[0]), boolean(c.Args[1])
	case "NewJSONParser":
		if len(c.Args) != 1 {
			panic("JSON arity")
		}
		r["capture_json_path"] = boolean(c.Args[0])
	case "NewDropLabels", "NewKeepLabels":
		if len(c.Args) != 1 {
			panic("drop/keep arity")
		}
		out := []object{}
		for _, elt := range c.Args[0].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
			v := elt.(*ast.CompositeLit)
			if len(v.Elts) != 2 {
				panic("named matcher fields")
			}
			m := s.record(v)
			m["name"] = text(s, v.Elts[1])
			m["matcher"] = nil
			if !isNil(v.Elts[0]) {
				m["matcher"] = matcher(s, v.Elts[0])
			}
			out = append(out, m)
		}
		r["named_matchers"] = out
		if name == "NewKeepLabels" && len(out) == 0 {
			r["constructor_noop"] = true
			r["public_grammar_form"] = nil
		}
	default:
		panic("unknown stage: " + name)
	}
	return r
}
func stages(s *source, e ast.Expr) []object {
	out := []object{}
	for _, v := range e.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
		out = append(out, stage(s, v))
	}
	return out
}
func pipelineStages(s *source, e ast.Expr) ([]object, object) {
	if a, ok := e.(*ast.TypeAssertExpr); ok {
		e = a.X
	}
	c := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	switch s.code(c.Fun) {
	case "NewNoopPipeline":
		if len(c.Args) != 0 {
			panic("noop arity")
		}
		return []object{}, s.record(e)
	case "NewPipeline":
		if len(c.Args) != 1 {
			panic("pipeline arity")
		}
		return stages(s, c.Args[0]), s.record(e)
	default:
		panic("unknown pipeline constructor")
	}
}
func newTable(s *source, name string) object {
	f := s.function(name)
	resetCalls, resetSetup := []object{}, []object{}
	ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
			if sel, ok := c.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && sel.Sel.Name == "Reset" {
				resetCalls = append(resetCalls, s.record(c))
			}
		}
		if a, ok := n.(*ast.AssignStmt); ok && len(a.Lhs) == 1 {
			if s.code(a.Lhs[0]) == "p.baseBuilder.del" || s.code(a.Lhs[0]) == "p.baseBuilder.add" {
				resetSetup = append(resetSetup, s.record(a))
			}
		}
		return true
	})
	return object{"name": name, "selection": s.selection(name, f), "assertion_calls": calls(s, f, "require."), "rows": []object{},
		"reset_calls_symbolic": resetCalls, "reset_setup_symbolic": resetSetup,
		"reset_assertions_symbolic": append(calls(s, f, "require.Len"), calls(s, f, "require.True")...)}
}
func addRow(t object, r object) {
	r["table"], r["source_index"] = t["name"], len(t["rows"].([]object))
	t["rows"] = append(t["rows"].([]object), r)
}
func processCall(s *source, e ast.Expr) (*ast.CallExpr, *ast.CallExpr, string, bool) {
	c, ok := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil, "", false
	}
	sel, ok := c.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
	if !ok || (sel.Sel.Name != "Process" && sel.Sel.Name != "ProcessString") {
		return nil, nil, "", false
	}
	fs, ok := sel.X.(*ast.CallExpr)
	if !ok {
		panic("unexpected stream construction")
	}
	fsel, ok := fs.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
	if !ok || fsel.Sel.Name != "ForStream" || len(fs.Args) != 1 || len(c.Args) != 3 {
		panic("unexpected Process shape")
	}
	return c, fs, sel.Sel.Name, true
}
func imperative(s *source, name string) object {
	t := newTable(s, name)
	f := s.function(name)
	env := map[string][]pair{}
	assignments := []object{}
	var current object
	var ps []object
	var constructor object
	for _, stmt := range f.Body.List {
		if a, ok := stmt.(*ast.AssignStmt); ok {
			if len(a.Rhs) != 1 {
				panic("unexpected assignment arity")
			}
			if c, fs, method, ok := processCall(s, a.Rhs[0]); ok {
				if len(a.Lhs) != 3 || ps == nil {
					panic("unexpected Process assignment")
				}
				input, isnil := lineValue(s, c.Args[1])
				if isnil {
					panic("nil input")
				}
				current = s.record(a)
				current["name"] = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", method, len(t["rows"].([]object)))
				current["input_index"] = 0
				current["method"], current["timestamp"], current["input_line"], current["input_line_bytes_base64"] = method, integer(c.Args[0]), input, bytes(input)
				current["stream_labels"], current["structured_metadata"] = labelsValue(s, fs.Args[0], env), labelsValue(s, c.Args[2], env)
				current["stream_labels_source"], current["structured_metadata_source"] = s.record(fs.Args[0]), s.record(c.Args[2])
				current["stages"], current["pipeline_constructor"], current["label_assignments"] = ps, constructor, append([]object{}, assignments...)
				current["assertions"], current["asserted_channels"] = []object{}, []string{}
				current["output_variables"] = []string{s.code(a.Lhs[0]), s.code(a.Lhs[1]), s.code(a.Lhs[2])}
				addRow(t, current)
				continue
			}
			lhs := s.code(a.Lhs[0])
			switch lhs {
			case "lbs", "structuredMetadata", "expectedLabelsResults", "expectedNonIndexedLabels":
				env[lhs] = labelsValue(s, a.Rhs[0], env)
				r := s.record(a)
				r["resolved_labels"] = copyPairs(env[lhs])
				assignments = append(assignments, r)
			case "p", "pipeline":
				ps, constructor = pipelineStages(s, a.Rhs[0])
			case "p.baseBuilder.del", "p.baseBuilder.add": // Reset setup remains symbolic in full function.
			default:
				panic("unexpected imperative assignment: " + lhs)
			}
			continue
		}
		if es, ok := stmt.(*ast.ExprStmt); ok {
			c := es.X.(*ast.CallExpr)
			if s.code(c.Fun) != "require.Equal" {
				continue
			} // Reset and require.Len stay symbolic.
			if current == nil || len(c.Args) != 3 {
				panic("unexpected imperative assertion")
			}
			current["assertions"] = append(current["assertions"].([]object), s.record(c))
			vars := current["output_variables"].([]string)
			actual := s.code(c.Args[2])
			exp := c.Args[1]
			channel := ""
			switch actual {
			case vars[0]:
				v, n := lineValue(s, exp)
				current["expected_line"], current["expected_line_bytes_base64"], current["expected_line_is_nil"] = v, bytes(v), n
				current["expected_line_source"] = s.record(exp)
				channel = "line"
			case vars[1]:
				channel = "labels_result"
				current["expected_labels_result_source"] = s.record(exp)
				current["expected_labels_result_is_nil"] = isNil(exp)
				if isNil(exp) {
					current["expected_labels"], current["expected_categories"] = nil, nil
					break
				}
				lr := exp.(*ast.CallExpr)
				if s.code(lr.Fun) != "NewLabelsResult" || len(lr.Args) != 5 {
					panic("unknown LabelsResult oracle")
				}
				st := lr.Args[0].(*ast.CallExpr)
				hs := lr.Args[1].(*ast.CallExpr)
				if len(st.Args) != 0 || s.code(hs.Fun) != "labels.StableHash" || len(hs.Args) != 1 {
					panic("unknown String/hash oracle")
				}
				ss := st.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
				if ss.Sel.Name != "String" || s.code(ss.X) != s.code(hs.Args[0]) {
					panic("String/hash references differ")
				}
				current["expected_labels"] = labelsValue(s, ss.X, env)
				current["expected_categories"] = object{"stream": labelsValue(s, lr.Args[2], env), "structured_metadata": labelsValue(s, lr.Args[3], env), "parsed": labelsValue(s, lr.Args[4], env)}
			case vars[2]:
				current["expected_match"] = boolean(exp)
				channel = "match"
			case vars[1] + ".Hash()":
				h := exp.(*ast.CallExpr)
				if s.code(h.Fun) != "labels.StableHash" || len(h.Args) != 1 {
					panic("unknown hash assertion")
				}
				labelsValue(s, h.Args[0], env) // Validate reference without computing hash.
				current["expected_hash_symbolic"] = s.record(exp)
				channel = "hash_symbolic"
			case vars[1] + ".String()":
				st := exp.(*ast.CallExpr)
				ss := st.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
				if ss.Sel.Name != "String" || len(st.Args) != 0 {
					panic("unknown String assertion")
				}
				labelsValue(s, ss.X, env)
				current["expected_string_symbolic"] = s.record(exp)
				channel = "string_symbolic"
			default:
				panic("unknown asserted channel: " + actual)
			}
			current["asserted_channels"] = append(current["asserted_channels"].([]string), channel)
		}
	}
	t["row_count"] = len(t["rows"].([]object))
	return t
}

func filtering(s *source) object {
	t := newTable(s, "TestFilteringPipeline")
	f := s.function("TestFilteringPipeline")
	table := f.Body.List[0].(*ast.AssignStmt).Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit)
	executor := f.Body.List[1].(*ast.RangeStmt)
	constructors := calls(s, executor, "NewFilteringPipeline")
	if len(constructors) != 1 {
		panic("filtering constructor count")
	}
	filters := []object{}
	ast.Inspect(executor, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
		if !ok || s.code(c.Fun) != "newPipelineFilter" {
			return true
		}
		if len(c.Args) != 5 {
			panic("filter constructor arity")
		}
		r := s.record(c)
		r["start"], r["end"] = integer(c.Args[0]), integer(c.Args[1])
		r["stream_labels"], r["structured_metadata"] = labelsValue(s, c.Args[2], nil), labelsValue(s, c.Args[3], nil)
		r["line_filter"], r["line_filter_operator_symbolic"] = literal(c.Args[4]), "LineMatchEqual"
		filters = append(filters, r)
		return true
	})
	if len(filters) != 3 {
		panic("filter count")
	}
	methodCalls := []object{}
	ast.Inspect(executor, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
			if sel, ok := c.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && (sel.Sel.Name == "Process" || sel.Sel.Name == "ProcessString") {
				r := s.record(c)
				r["method"] = sel.Sel.Name
				methodCalls = append(methodCalls, r)
			}
		}
		return true
	})
	if len(methodCalls) != 2 {
		panic("filtering method count")
	}
	for _, elt := range table.Elts {
		v := elt.(*ast.CompositeLit)
		if len(v.Elts) != 6 {
			panic("filtering row shape")
		}
		r := s.record(v)
		input := literal(v.Elts[2])
		r["name"], r["timestamp"], r["input_line"], r["input_line_bytes_base64"] = literal(v.Elts[0]), integer(v.Elts[1]), input, bytes(input)
		r["stream_labels"], r["structured_metadata"] = labelsValue(s, v.Elts[3], nil), labelsValue(s, v.Elts[4], nil)
		r["expected_match"], r["filters"], r["contract"] = boolean(v.Elts[5]), filters, "symbolic_deletion_wrapper_not_public_query"
		r["expected_match_source"] = s.record(v.Elts[5])
		r["asserted_channels"] = []string{"match", "downstream_reset_called_symbolic"}
		r["methods"] = []string{"Process", "ProcessString"}
		r["pipeline_constructor"], r["downstream_constructor"] = constructors[0], calls(s, executor, "newStubPipeline")[0]
		r["method_calls"] = methodCalls
		addRow(t, r)
	}
	t["table_source"], t["executor"], t["row_count"] = s.record(table), s.record(executor), len(t["rows"].([]object))
	t["contract"] = "symbolic_deletion_wrapper_not_public_query"
	return t
}

func dropKeep(s *source, name string) object {
	t := newTable(s, name)
	f := s.function(name)
	var table *ast.CompositeLit
	var executor *ast.RangeStmt
	if name == "TestDropLabelsPipeline" {
		table = f.Body.List[0].(*ast.AssignStmt).Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit)
		executor = f.Body.List[1].(*ast.RangeStmt)
	} else {
		executor = f.Body.List[0].(*ast.RangeStmt)
		table = executor.X.(*ast.CompositeLit)
	}
	constructors := calls(s, executor, "NewPipeline")
	if len(constructors) != 1 {
		panic("drop/keep pipeline count")
	}
	var hashOracle, stringOracle object
	ast.Inspect(executor, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
		if !ok || s.code(c.Fun) != "require.Equal" {
			return true
		}
		if len(c.Args) != 3 {
			panic("drop/keep assertion arity")
		}
		switch s.code(c.Args[2]) {
		case "finalLbs.Hash()":
			if s.code(c.Args[1]) != "labels.StableHash(tt.wantLabels[i])" {
				panic("unknown table hash oracle")
			}
			hashOracle = s.record(c.Args[1])
		case "finalLbs.String()":
			if s.code(c.Args[1]) != "tt.wantLabels[i].String()" {
				panic("unknown table String oracle")
			}
			stringOracle = s.record(c.Args[1])
		}
		return true
	})
	if hashOracle == nil || (name == "TestKeepLabelsPipeline" && stringOracle == nil) {
		panic("missing symbolic table oracle")
	}
	for _, elt := range table.Elts {
		v := elt.(*ast.CompositeLit)
		if len(v.Elts) != 5 {
			panic("drop/keep row fields")
		}
		fields := map[string]ast.Expr{}
		for i, e := range v.Elts {
			if name == "TestDropLabelsPipeline" {
				fields[[]string{"name", "stages", "lines", "wantLine", "wantLabels"}[i]] = e
			} else {
				kv := e.(*ast.KeyValueExpr)
				fields[s.code(kv.Key)] = kv.Value
			}
		}
		r := s.record(v)
		r["name"] = literal(fields["name"])
		r["stages"] = stages(s, fields["stages"])
		r["pipeline_constructor"] = constructors[0]
		lines := fields["lines"].(*ast.CompositeLit)
		wants := fields["wantLine"].(*ast.CompositeLit)
		labs := fields["wantLabels"].(*ast.CompositeLit)
		if len(lines.Elts) != len(wants.Elts) || len(lines.Elts) != len(labs.Elts) {
			panic("line/oracle arity mismatch")
		}
		inputs := []object{}
		for i, line := range lines.Elts {
			input, n := lineValue(s, line)
			if n {
				panic("nil input")
			}
			want, wn := lineValue(s, wants.Elts[i])
			if wn {
				panic("nil table wantLine")
			}
			expected := labelsValue(s, labs.Elts[i], nil)
			x := s.record(line)
			x["table"], x["source_index"], x["input_index"], x["name"] = name, len(t["rows"].([]object)), i, literal(fields["name"])
			x["method"], x["timestamp"], x["input_line"], x["input_line_bytes_base64"] = "Process", int64(0), input, bytes(input)
			x["stages"], x["pipeline_constructor"] = r["stages"], constructors[0]
			x["stream_labels"], x["structured_metadata"] = []pair{}, []pair{}
			x["expected_labels"], x["expected_labels_source"] = expected, s.record(labs.Elts[i])
			x["expected_categories"] = object{"stream": []pair{}, "structured_metadata": []pair{}, "parsed": expected}
			x["expected_match"] = nil // Original executor discards matches; never manufacture true.
			x["want_line"], x["want_line_bytes_base64"], x["want_line_source"] = want, bytes(want), s.record(wants.Elts[i])
			x["want_line_asserted"] = name == "TestKeepLabelsPipeline"
			x["expected_line"], x["expected_line_bytes_base64"] = nil, nil
			x["asserted_channels"] = []string{"labels", "stream", "structured_metadata", "parsed", "hash_symbolic"}
			x["expected_hash_symbolic"] = hashOracle
			if name == "TestKeepLabelsPipeline" {
				x["expected_line"], x["expected_line_bytes_base64"], x["expected_line_is_nil"] = want, bytes(want), false
				x["asserted_channels"] = []string{"line", "labels", "stream", "structured_metadata", "parsed", "hash_symbolic", "string_symbolic"}
				x["expected_string_symbolic"] = stringOracle
			}
			x["assertions"] = t["assertion_calls"]
			inputs = append(inputs, x)
		}
		r["inputs"], r["input_count"] = inputs, len(inputs)
		addRow(t, r)
	}
	t["table_source"], t["executor"], t["row_count"] = s.record(table), s.record(executor), len(t["rows"].([]object))
	return t
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki")
	}
	root := os.Args[1]
	s := load(root, "pkg/logql/log/pipeline_test.go", "d077ffbf7c67db32416395fb910dbc0440b75e08360ccace3319bfe821888bc2")
	e := load(root, "pkg/logql/log/error.go", "d836fe896703aaa92d53baa61e6532c605344261460af3bab3994d531fa14458")
	m := load(root, "pkg/logqlmodel/error.go", "21816c4294243f16157f6408d92fb0907612a3258333288ab39b3f84bf7a4db5")
	fmtSource := load(root, "pkg/logql/log/fmt_test.go", "58955c60c2ff68f91a5f0777208e49180d194c290c3bbb36f3145911f1f22ff6")
	support := []object{}
	for _, src := range []*source{e, m} {
		for _, d := range src.file.Decls {
			g, ok := d.(*ast.GenDecl)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			for _, spec := range g.Specs {
				v, ok := spec.(*ast.ValueSpec)
				if !ok || len(v.Names) != 1 {
					continue
				}
				name := v.Names[0].Name
				alias := name
				if src == m {
					alias = "logqlmodel." + name
				}
				if alias != "errJSON" && alias != "errLogfmt" && alias != "logqlmodel.ErrorLabel" && alias != "logqlmodel.ErrorDetailsLabel" {
					continue
				}
				if len(v.Values) != 1 {
					panic("alias value arity")
				}
				aliases[alias] = literal(v.Values[0])
				r := src.record(v)
				r["name"], r["value"], r["sha256"] = alias, aliases[alias], hash([]byte(src.code(v)))
				support = append(support, r)
			}
		}
	}
	if len(aliases) != 4 {
		panic("alias count")
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"appendLabels", "newPipelineFilter", "newStubPipeline", "ForStream", "Reset", "BaseLabels", "Process", "ProcessString", "ReferencedStructuredMetadata", "mustFilter"} {
		support = append(support, s.selection(name, s.function(name)))
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"stubPipeline", "stubStreamPipeline"} {
		found := false
		for _, d := range s.file.Decls {
			g, ok := d.(*ast.GenDecl)
			if !ok || g.Tok != token.TYPE {
				continue
			}
			for _, spec := range g.Specs {
				if v := spec.(*ast.TypeSpec); v.Name.Name == name {
					support = append(support, s.selection(name, g))
					found = true
				}
			}
		}
		if !found {
			panic("missing stub type")
		}
	}
	support = append(support, fmtSource.selection("newMustLineFormatter", fmtSource.function("newMustLineFormatter")))
	tables := []object{imperative(s, "TestNoopPipeline"), imperative(s, "TestPipeline"), imperative(s, "TestPipelineWithStructuredMetadata"), filtering(s), dropKeep(s, "TestDropLabelsPipeline"), dropKeep(s, "TestKeepLabelsPipeline")}
	executions := []object{}
	rows, assertions := 0, 0
	methodCounts := map[string]int{"Process": 0, "ProcessString": 0}
	wantRows := []int{5, 4, 8, 9, 2, 3}
	for i, t := range tables {
		r := t["rows"].([]object)
		if len(r) != wantRows[i] {
			panic("pinned row counts differ")
		}
		rows += len(r)
		assertions += len(t["assertion_calls"].([]object))
		for _, row := range r {
			if i == 3 {
				methodCounts["Process"]++
				methodCounts["ProcessString"]++
				continue
			}
			xs := []object{row}
			if i >= 4 {
				xs = row["inputs"].([]object)
			}
			for _, x := range xs {
				x["execution_id"] = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d/%v/%s", t["name"], row["source_index"], x["input_index"], x["method"])
				executions = append(executions, x)
				methodCounts[x["method"].(string)]++
			}
		}
	}
	if rows != 31 || len(executions) != 30 || methodCounts["Process"] != 31 || methodCounts["ProcessString"] != 17 || assertions != 95 {
		panic("pinned aggregate counts differ")
	}
	sources := []object{}
	for _, src := range []*source{s, e, m, fmtSource} {
		sources = append(sources, object{"path": src.path, "sha256": hash(src.data)})
	}
	out := object{"schema_version": 1, "revision": revision, "sources": sources, "supporting_declarations": support, "tables": tables,
		"row_count": rows, "executions": executions, "execution_count": len(executions), "source_execution_count": 48, "symbolic_filtering_execution_count": 18,
		"method_counts": methodCounts, "execution_method_counts": object{"Process": 22, "ProcessString": 8}, "assertion_call_site_count": assertions,
		"qualification": "Source extraction only; no Loki/Pulse execution, calculated output, literal hash, cache behavior or public deletion API claim."}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	must(enc.Encode(out))
}
